name: A-04-morning-market
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone landscape 16:9 illustration for the Kokomonster Japanese-learning landing page. No sheet, panels, title, labels, lettering, UI or logo. Style A — Flat Adventure: broad crisp flat colour shapes, minimal outlines, selective thin interior strokes, simple clean cheerful silhouettes. Environment must use the SAME simplified graphic language: 8–12 broad architectural shapes, foliage in 3 flat masses, no detailed woodgrain, realistic lighting, anime background, texture, grain or gradient. Cream background #FFF9EF, soft muted scenery, brighter characters, ample whitespace. Images 1 and 2 establish style A and character identities; image 3 is ONLY Tree's canonical face/nose reference, do not use its costume or rendering.
CRITICAL TREE NOSE: copy the gym reference's visible vertical TERRACOTTA nose precisely: a tall rounded triangular/teardrop shape with rounded apex and broad curved base, centred between eyes and separate from mouth. One flat warm dusty terracotta fill, no outline, no highlight, no nostrils, no black tip. Width about one eye diameter, height about 1.6 eye diameters. Never a tiny dot or pointed sharp triangle. Exactly same nose construction in every new scene. Tree has brown pointed grooved chestnut crown, pale peach face, round coral cheeks, pink petal NECK COLLAR, green ribbed compact body/mitten hands, pink legs and black shoes. No costume additions.
Other cast as specified: Koko blue monkey peach face/ears/feet red cheeks/chest heart curved tail, consistent black filled nose short stem/W muzzle, no shorts. Gohanko white flared body black fringe/side buns ochre brim hat, black bib red torso circle, visible black oval nose above separate smile, round blue/red accessory. Bear brown compact stocky bear beige muzzle black oval nose angular brow white/turquoise lower garment. Rabbit pink long ears, black forehead curl AND distinct black nose on lower muzzle, bilateral red cheek wedges, red scarf, pink paws. Yauyau charcoal hood black face white eyes/mouth red floating sphere, legless, EXACTLY TWO red scarf-arms from neck ring terminating one hand each, no third tail or red cheeks.
Keep faces large and visible, maintain compact source proportions, natural prop grip, don't hide signature noses.
SCENE: Morning conversation at a small Japanese neighbourhood produce stall. Exactly Koko, Gohanko and Tree, no other people. Scene clustered in RIGHT 62%, LEFT 38% blank cream for live heading/CTA. A simple striped indigo awning, two wooden crates with daikon and mikan, small shopping basket. Tree is friendly stall keeper behind low counter, visible whole face and upper green body, offering one mikan to Gohanko. Gohanko reaches to accept it, Koko beside her consults a small pocket phrasebook. Faces mostly front/three-quarter, Tree nose clear. Friendly eye contact and conversation gesture. No text or speech bubbles. Three large characters rather than a crowd. Ground dissolves into cream with simple bounded flat patches, not gradient.
